column3: The Hebrew calls him lifted in face; BSB says highly regarded.
The Hebrew says she was before his wife; BSB describes serving her.
The Hebrew wishes him before the prophet; BSB supplies going to him.
The Hebrew leaves the man unnamed; BSB supplies Naaman.
The Hebrew leaves the traveler unnamed and the unit of gold implicit; BSB supplies Naaman and shekels.
The Hebrew first describes bringing the letter; BSB makes the letter the subject of stating its message.

The Hebrew uses singular chariotry; BSB uses plural chariots.
The Hebrew says the flesh returns with an active verb; BSB expresses restoration passively.

The Hebrew leaves the servants’ master unnamed; BSB supplies Naaman.
The Hebrew leaves the man unnamed and repeats flesh; BSB names Naaman and replaces the second flesh reference with that.
The Hebrew leaves Naaman unnamed and calls the company his camp and the gift a blessing; BSB supplies Naaman and uses attendants and gift.
The Hebrew leaves both men unnamed; BSB supplies Elisha and Naaman.
The Hebrew uses plural other gods; BSB uses singular any other god.
The Hebrew says my hand, names the house of Rimmon three times, and repeats bowing; BSB uses my arm and condenses the repetitions.
The Hebrew leaves both men unnamed; BSB supplies Elisha and Naaman.
The Hebrew explicitly mentions taking from his hand; BSB leaves the hand implicit.
The Hebrew says he fell from the chariot and asks Peace?; BSB says got down and asks Is everything all right?
The Hebrew leaves the speaker unnamed and simply says the men have come; BSB supplies Gehazi and adds a discovery.
The Hebrew leaves the urged man and the final man followed unnamed; BSB names Gehazi twice.
The Hebrew leaves the arriving man unnamed and says he took from their hand; BSB supplies Gehazi, the gifts, and the servants.
The Hebrew leaves the arriving man unnamed; BSB supplies Gehazi.
The Hebrew says my heart and leaves the speaker unnamed; BSB says my spirit and supplies Elisha.
The Hebrew uses collective singular seed and leaves the departing man unnamed; BSB uses descendants and supplies Gehazi. BSB also adds white to the snow comparison.
